_doc: The guardian, on Throne (Rival, Neoni; song bars 80-136). Three phases on the guardian's own body. The waking (bars 0-15): at its feet, it stirs, its head comes up, its hand sweeps across the ring (each sweep telegraphed a bar ahead in vermilion; you hop it on the beat); Helion's signal from inside its chest (8). The climb (16-31): at 16 the heavy bars throw you onto its raised arm (17-19, the Meteor through its seals), at 20 a throw to its helm, and you wind round it and in toward the slit (24-29, the seals breaking); 30-31 near silence: its heart opens. The heart (32-55): the drop throws you onto the great Star-Node in its chest; the four Kindlings come one by one and each gives its mode back (Emberwick's Meteor 33, Cirra's wave 37, Glassmere's ball 41, Verdance's snap 45); at 49 Helion's signal joins as the second spark (dual) and the camera pulls back over the whole guardian; the last tap lights its star (55).
Every bar is charted by hand (tools/journey.py from tools/journeys.py, then hand-tuned if need be). The id is the world's slot, not the song.
title: Throne
adds: Everything the four worlds gave, in turn, on the guardian's own body; and two sparks on one tap

setpieces.name: It wakes
setpieces.what: the guardian kneeling at the edge of the galaxy stirs; its head comes up and the slit in its helm lights cold

setpieces.name: The first sweep
setpieces.what: a bar ahead a vermilion line crosses the ring; on the beat its hand sweeps through, and you hop it

setpieces.name: Helion's moment
setpieces.what: his signal, from inside the guardian's chest: the nearest it has ever been

setpieces.name: The climb
setpieces.what: the heavy bars throw you onto its raised arm; the Meteor through its seals

setpieces.name: The helm
setpieces.what: a throw to its helm; you wind round it and in toward the slit, the seals breaking

setpieces.name: Its heart opens
setpieces.what: near silence; the Stillness pours out of the slit and the Star-Node in its chest shows

setpieces.name: The heart
setpieces.what: the drop: the great node, a beat of stillness, the impact; thrown onto the Star-Node in its chest

setpieces.name: The Kindlings
setpieces.what: one by one the four Kindlings come and each gives its mode back: the Meteor (33), the wave (37), the ball (41), the snap (45)

setpieces.name: Two sparks
setpieces.what: Helion's signal joins as the second spark (dual); the camera pulls back over the whole guardian

setpieces.name: Its star
setpieces.what: the last tap lights the guardian's star; it bows its head, this time by choice
